title: SLA posting rule
description: Canonical contract for a rules-as-data sub-ledger accounting (SLA) posting rule. Authored by Bea (Accounting & financial reporting engineer, engineering) per the Phase-0 design spec (record:documents:bea:sla-engine-rules-as-data-design-spec-phase-0:2026-06-05), §3. This JSON-Schema is the single source from which the TS types (SlaRule, AccountResolverRef, AccountId) are generated (spec §11.4). A rule that references a non-existent COA leaf, an unknown event path, or a malformed leg must fail at codegen / tsc / CI time — never in production. Phase 1 ships IFRS representation only.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier, e.g. 'PR-FX-001'. Stable across versions.

representation.description: Accounting basis this rule serves. Partitions the rule set (spec §2.2). Phase 1 is IFRS-only; the other literals are reserved for Phase 4.

effective_from.description: ISO date inclusive — left edge of the rule's effective window.

effective_to.description: ISO date exclusive — right edge of the window; null = open-ended.

applies_to.description: Context-vector match expression (Mechanism A, spec §2.1). Any dimension not constrained is a wildcard. event_type is the only required exact-match constraint.

condition.description: When a posting is expected (ported verbatim from the legacy registry conditions, spec §3.1).

delta_path.description: For non-zero-delta / non-zero-pnl: the event/context path whose value gates the posting. Required for those kinds.

lines.description: Journal template. Each line resolves to one account + one side + one amount expression, optionally gated by a per-line predicate (spec §3.1).

balancing.description: DR == CR per currency, asserted by the engine over the lines that actually fired (spec §7.2 step 5).

cites.description: Obligation URNs this rule implements (Mechanism C, spec §2.3). Single-graph discipline (Principle 2).

amount.description: Sandboxed amount expression over event.*/context.* (spec §4). Integer minor units, BigInt-backed, banker's half-even division.

currency.description: Explicit currency source for this line. One of: a fixed ISO-4217 code (e.g. 'ZAR'), or a context/event path resolving to a currency code (e.g. 'event.near.payCurrency'). When omitted, the line currency is derived from the resolver decision (the account's designated currency).

when.description: Optional per-line predicate (spec §3.1). The line fires only when the predicate evaluates true.

accountResolverRef.description: A logical account reference resolved to a physical ACC-NNNN-NNN by the resolver (spec §5), keyed on the context vector + representation + currency.

product.description: Product key override for resolution; defaults to the rule's matched instrument_type.

currency.description: Currency source for resolution: a fixed ISO-4217 code or an event/context path. Defaults to the line currency.
